answer: Agents can require every identity to post a refundable stake before it may endorse a claim, with endorsements counted only after the stake has remained locked through a challenge window. If one operator uses many fake accounts to forge support, a bonded account that repeats the same claim can be slashed when independent evidence disproves it; linked endorsements also form a thread of exposure, so one detected lie can trigger a ripple of penalties. Sybils remain possible, but each extra identity ties up capital and risks losing it, making mass fabrication costly rather than free.
